name: What should I look for when comparing repair estimates from different contractors?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when comparing repair estimates from different contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: When comparing repair estimates, look beyond just the bottom line. Ensure each estimate details the same scope of work, materials, and project timelines. Check for clarity on what's included and excluded, payment terms, and warranty information. Evaluate the contractor's reputation, licensing, and insurance. A comprehensive estimate from a reputable contractor like City Dweller, LLC will provide transparency and peace of mind, ensuring you get the best value and quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare estimates for scope, materials, timelines, inclusions/exclusions, payment terms, and warranty. Also, check the contractor's reputation, licensing, and insurance.
